title: compliance-milestone-orchestration-index-and-cycle-owners
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a single, cycle-aligned orchestration index that consolidates all compliance/security milestones (SOC2, ISO 27001, SSO/SAML rollouts, audit log coverage) into an actionable, owner-assigned tracker. The index will serve as the canonical source of truth for PM/Eng/Design stakeholders, provide evidence status (not started / in progress / evidence uploaded / verified), expose automation hooks for reminders and dashboards, and emit alerts for milestones at risk. This is intended to replace ad-hoc spreadsheets and fragmented Confluence pages and to integrate with the Redwood Console compliance dashboard and engineering runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Single JSON/CSV exportable index exists with one row per milestone and columns: milestone_key, title, owner, cycle, status, evidence_url, verification_status, linked_prs, linked_runbook
Owners assigned for each milestone and confirmed by stakeholders (PM/Eng/Design) in the 2026-W11 planning session
Automation: Weekly reminder sent to owners for milestones with status 'evidence required' and a Slack thread created in #trust-compliance for exceptions
Integration: Index is visible in Console->Compliance tab via a new 'Milestone Rollup' endpoint (read-only) and a Confluence page auto-synced for auditors
Acceptance test: Simulate SOC2 control A.2 and demonstrate evidence flow from task -> evidence_url -> verification_status updated by auditor user with corresponding dashboard metric update
plan: Week 1 (2026-03-10 to 2026-03-16): Discovery workshop with Eng/Design/Security to enumerate milestones and owners; consolidate existing Confluence pages and spreadsheets (owner: Marco Diaz)
Week 2: Define canonical schema for the index and build lightweight CRUD API for PMs to edit (owner: Eng - SRE team; contact ENG-4120)
Week 3: Implement Confluence and Slack syncs (owner: Developer Relations); create evidence templates and PR templates for linked PRs
Week 4: Hook index into Console UI as 'Milestone Rollup' beta; soft-launch with Trust team and gather feedback
Cycle 2 (April): Add automated verification step for audit evidence and exportable evidence pack generator for external auditors
